replacements.La productividad cae antes de subir: la: Productivity falls before it rises: the J-Curve of general-purpose technologies
replacements.Adoptar una tecnología de propósito gene: Adopting a general-purpose technology first creates a visible reorganization cost. The benefit comes later, when processes are redesigned to exploit what the technology makes possible. That is what happened with electricity. That is what is happening with AI.
replacements.Los cuatro mecanismos del desfase: The four mechanisms behind the lag
replacements.Curva J de productividad: caída inicial: Productivity J-Curve: an initial decline followed by a recovery above baseline
replacements.La productividad total de los factores (: Total factor productivity (TFP) can appear stagnant or even decline during the adoption phase of a general-purpose technology because the intangible capital needed to complement it — knowledge, redesigned processes and organization — takes time to accumulate and is not measured well in national accounts.
replacements.Las primeras fábricas que instalaron mot: The first factories to install electric motors did not immediately change their productivity. The jump came 20–30 years later, when factories were redesigned around what electricity made possible and mechanical transmission could not.
replacements.Una sola fuente de potencia central (vap: A single central power source — steam or water — distributed energy through pulleys, belts and shafts to every machine. The factory layout depended on the geometry of mechanical transmission, not on the production process.
replacements.Las primeras fábricas electrificadas sim: The first electrified factories simply replaced the steam shaft with a central electric motor while keeping the same layout. Same process, different energy source. The reorganization cost was real; the benefit was minimal.
replacements.Los ingenieros se dieron cuenta de que l: Engineers realized that electricity made it possible to deliver power exactly where it was needed. They redesigned the factory: each machine had its own motor, and workflows were optimized around the process rather than the transmission system. The productivity jump was now possible.
replacements.Robert Gordon documentó este patrón en \: Robert Gordon documented this pattern in "The Rise and Fall of American Growth" (Princeton, 2016). An economist looking at the productivity data of an 1895 factory sees costs with no return. Looking at the same transition in 1925 reveals the return, 30 years later.
replacements.Por qué el desfase ocurre siempre con la: Why the lag repeatedly appears with general-purpose technologies. Each mechanism operates in parallel, and all of them must be resolved before the macroeconomic impact becomes visible.
replacements.Las empresas necesitan tiempo para apren: Companies need time to learn, evaluate and find the use cases where the return is real. Generative AI has been widely available since 2022–2023, and most companies are still in the exploration phase rather than mature deployment.
replacements.Para capturar el valor de la IA, las emp: To capture AI's value, companies need to change how they work, not merely add a tool to an existing process. That requires organizational change, overcoming internal resistance and time. It is the equivalent of redesigning the factory floor.
replacements.El valor de la IA en una empresa no está: The value of AI inside a company is not only in the software, but also in the knowledge of how to use it, the proprietary data that feeds it and the processes redesigned around it. That intangible capital does not appear on balance sheets or in GDP, which makes part of both the cost and the return invisible.
replacements.La IA crea más valor cuando complementa: AI creates more value when it complements other investments: worker training, data infrastructure and management systems. The full impact arrives when all of those pieces are in place, not when the first model is installed. Building those complements takes years.
replacements.Curva J con marcador de posición actual: J-Curve with a marker for AI's current position in 2024–2025
replacements.Las señales de dónde estamos realmente: Signals of where we actually are
replacements.Solo el 1% de las empresas ha alcanzado: Only 1% of companies have reached maturity
replacements.McKinsey (2024) define madurez como inte: McKinsey (2024) defines maturity as deep AI integration into business processes with documented return metrics. The remaining 99% are in exploration, pilot or partial-adoption stages.
replacements.20-50% de reducción de tiempo en tareas: 20–50% time reductions in specific tasks such as coding, analysis and writing. AlphaFold accelerated protein-structure prediction by ×45,000. These are early signals of potential, not yet evidence of macroeconomic impact.
replacements.La paradoja del bienestar percibido vs p: The paradox of perceived gains vs measured productivity
replacements.Encuestas entre usuarios de IA en entorn: Surveys of AI users in professional settings show significant perceived productivity gains, but when those gains are sought in institutional production data, the effects are systematically smaller or not statistically detectable. Saved time is redistributed toward tasks that did not previously exist, unmeasured quality or work reorganization.
